# oasdiff --err-ignore list for ci.yml's api-breaking-changes job.
# Every entry must be a change oasdiff reports as breaking that provably
# isn't for any existing client — say why above it. A real breaking change
# is marked `feat!`/`BREAKING CHANGE:` instead, never listed here.
# Format: "<METHOD> <path> <oasdiff message>", one per line ('#' lines and
# lines matching nothing are inert).

# Issue #130: the paged `CommentsPage` shape is only returned when the client
# sends the new opt-in `take`/`cursor` query parameters; every request an
# existing client makes still gets the bare array.
GET /api/posts/{postId}/comments added `#/components/schemas/CommentsPage, subschema #1` to the response body `oneOf` list for the response status `200`
GET /api/posts/{postId}/comments the response's body `type` changed from `array<object>` to `any` for status `200`
